leadText: Ryan Nicolls is a voice actor for the English-language dub of and the I Choose You! trilogy.
plainText:
Ryan Nicolls is a voice actor for the English-language dub of and the I Choose You! trilogy.

==Biography==
Nicolls was born sometime on March 6 in Sacramento, California. As an adult, he became a voice actor and became involved with a number of English-dubbed versions of international shows. He joined the during . His most notable role so far in that work is Laki. Nicolls currently resides in New York City, New York, with his wife, Laurie Hymes, who also voices characters in . Nicolls departed from the series in February 2021.
